'''Neural regeneration''' was the regeneration of [[Brain/Legends|brain]] tissue. While discussing the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|storehouse]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] told [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] that [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] had undergone this procedure.<ref name="Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
